idea-plugin.name: Code Cat
idea-plugin.description:
Explore TypeScript, JavaScript, and Python projects through an AI conversation connected to source code and real debugger pauses.

Ask a question, follow a source location, then choose when to start debugging. Code Cat keeps observations and follow-up questions in one conversation. It distinguishes captured pause evidence from source-based inference.

This experimental preview has been tested with WebStorm 2025.1.3 for TypeScript breakpoints. The separate PyCharm 2026.1 local build loads without the NodeJS IDE plugin; Python breakpoints are not yet verified. The JetBrains host currently captures the paused location and nearby source, but not debugger variables or a complete call stack. Node.js 20+ is required for Code Cat's local engine and is detected automatically; your own supported model API key is also required. Model requests can include excerpts of project source code. See the privacy notice and setup guide.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Code questions now start with purpose and responsibility before following a source path. The pause view separates source clues from observed facts, shows capture limits, and offers editable follow-up questions. Debug launch checks the chosen entry against the breakpoint target.
